# 2 bed apartment for sale

> Chesser Auctioneers are delighted to present Apartment 205, The Park to the market, a spacious and well laid out two-bedroom apartment situated in the heart of Limerick City overlooking the famous people`s park. Ideally positioned, this property offers exceptional convenience with a wide range of amenities right on its doorstep.
